messages.en: I just want to take a day off tomorrow.
Okay, have you told the boss yet?

senses.en_definition: Should; ought to; used to express what is proper or reasonably expected.

messages.en: I've already headed off. I thought you were going to meet me there.
You should've told me first. We agreed to go together, remember? I've been waiting for you all this time.
Sorry, I got the wrong idea. Wait there a sec. I'll come back and pick you up.

senses.en_definition: Until; up to a specified point in time, place, or degree.

collocations.en: until the end of the year

senses.en_definition: Until a particular state is reached; to such an extent that a particular result follows.

collocations.en: to the point of causing losses

messages.en: I'm so sleepy... I stayed up watching a drama until two in the morning last night 😂
No wonder you've been so quiet this morning. Get to bed a bit earlier tonight.

senses.en_definition: Since; from a particular time or stage of life onward.

collocations.en: since long ago; since ancient times

messages.en: We hardly see each other since you moved so far away, do we? Let's grab a drink this Saturday.
I know, I miss hanging out with you too. Saturday afternoon works for me. The usual place?
